author: The Infographics Show
description:
You’ve probably heard that the artificial intelligence revolution is running out of money, but the truth is much worse. It’s running out of power.

Right now, an unprecedented energy crunch has forced Big Tech into a quiet desperation, leading to the delay or cancellation of roughly 50% of American data center projects. Silicon Valley can’t simply code its way out of this physical bottleneck. To save their investments, companies like Microsoft, Amazon, and Google are transforming into infrastructure monopolies, quietly buying up nuclear power plants and bypassing public grids entirely.
